description: List a company's reports — metadata only (id, title, period), no body text. Each item carries a `source` field naming the official disclosure platform; keep that attribution when you cite it. Look up by `symbol` (FMP-style, e.g. AAPL / 600519.SS / NABIL.NP) or by `exchange` + `stock_code` (from list_stocks) for markets whose codes aren't ticker-shaped (e.g. Brazil CNPJ, Sri Lanka 'AAA.N0000').

doc_type.description: Report type to filter on: annual / semiannual / q1 / q3. Defaults to annual. Pass semiannual for half-year reports, q1 / q3 for the quarterly reports.

exchange.description: Exchange code (from list_exchanges). Use with stock_code when the code isn't ticker-shaped.

stock_code.description: Exact stock_code from list_stocks. Use with exchange.

name: list_reports
